source.title: DISA Control Correlation Identifier (CCI) List, publish date 2025-01-23

CCI-000382.text: Configure the system to prohibit or restrict the use of organization-defined prohibited or restricted functions, system ports, protocols, software, and/or services.

CCI-001665.text: Preserve organization-defined system state information in the event of a system failure.

CCI-002235.text: Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions.

CCI-002314.text: Employ automated mechanisms to control remote access methods.
